subject: Verdant Labs MSA + Order Form — clause heatmap and initial redline asks
body:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle@verdantlabs.com>; Marcus Lee <marcus@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Verdant Labs MSA + Order Form — clause heatmap and initial redline asks

Hi Janelle / Marcus —

Great to kick this off. Attached are the draft MSA and the order form Verdant shared earlier (we consolidated the blank fields). A few asks to keep the contracting window tight: 

- Can you confirm whether Verdant needs a vendor-specific Data Processing Addendum or will the standard DPA suffice?
- Please highlight 3–5 clauses you consider non-starters (e.g., indemnity cap, residency language, termination for convenience). We will prioritize those in our redline.
- Procurement contact added? If procurement@verdantlabs.com should receive billing/invoice flow, add them to replies.

Attachments: Verdant_MSA_v1.docx, Verdant_OrderForm_20270612.xlsx

Proposed turnaround: we can deliver a marked PDF + clause heatmap by EOD Tue (06/15) if we get your prioritized items by EOD Mon (06/14). If you prefer we can do a quick 20m sync to align.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

-----
From: Janelle Park <janelle@verdantlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>; Marcus Lee <marcus@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: procurement@verdantlabs.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Labs MSA + Order Form — clause heatmap and initial redline asks

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for sending. Quick answers: 
1) We need a vendor-specific DPA because of our EU customers; I can share Verdant's DPA template this afternoon.
2) Priority items for us: data residency (Exhibit B), indemnity (Section 11), and insurance thresholds.
3) Looped in procurement. Procurement lead is Marcus Lee (copied).

Two additional notes: 
- We usually require a statement of subcontractors and an audit rights clause (audit rights limited to SOC/Security evidence is preferred).
- For billing, Verdant prefers net-45 on initial orders; will that be an issue?

Can you confirm whether Redwood requires any attestation for customer data deletion? If so, please point us to the language.

Best,
Janelle Park
Senior Counsel, Verdant Labs
janelle@verdantlabs.com

-----
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle@verdantlabs.com>; Marcus Lee <marcus@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Labs MSA + Order Form — clause heatmap and initial redline asks

Perfect — thank you for the clarity. Next steps from our side: 

1) I will upload Verdant's DPA when you send it; Marissa will confirm compatibility with our standard DPA.
2) Marissa/Kimberly: please prioritize Exhibit B residency language and Section 11 indemnity for a first-pass redline. If insurance requires an uplift we should flag to Sofia for commercial visibility.
3) Procurement: net-45 request noted — Sofia will flag pricing team and post-term team for finance signoff; we'll flag any billing exceptions in the redline.

Proposed meeting: Mon 06/14 09:00 PT for 20 minutes to align on the heatmap before redlines are circulated. If that works for Verdant please confirm.

Thanks —
Sofia

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Janelle Park <janelle@verdantlabs.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Labs MSA + Order Form — clause heatmap and initial redline asks

Hi all —

Thanks for the direction, Janelle. I reviewed the draft MSA and can commit to the EOD Tue deliverable for a redline + a short clause heatmap. A couple of internal asks so we can make the first pass useful: 

- Sofia: please share any customer-specific Exhibit B requirements (residency jurisdictions) Verdant expects.
- Janelle: if Verdant has a preferred insurance schedule, please attach; otherwise we'll propose our standard thresholds and call out the delta.
- Marcus / procurement@verdantlabs.com: confirm the billing cadence preference (net-45) so we can mark commercial exceptions.

I uploaded a short template we use for the heatmap and the redline legend here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bVerdantShared (see redline-legend.pdf).

We will produce: 
- Marked MSA (track changes)
- Clause heatmap (priority + recommended disposition)
- Redline checklist for commercial/finance exceptions

If okay, I'll schedule a 20-minute sync for Mon 06/14 09:00 PT and send an invite.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced (stubs): Verdant_MSA_v1.docx (incoming from Verdant), Verdant_OrderForm_20270612.xlsx (incoming), redline-legend.pdf (internal template)
